description:
Low Poly CVPI P71 I modelled in Blender for a L4D2 game mod project. Textures were made in Substance Painter, this is the Taxi version

Addon: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2776474002

The CVPI is loosely modelled off the 2001 Ford Crown Victoria. Proportions are not 100% correct since I literally only have reference images to work with.

Materials: 2k
Normal Map: DirectX

*You’re free to use this model in your personal projects or commercial products under CC Attribution License. The least I’m asking is to credit me for modelling this asset.*
